lede: The biggest item this week is Town Council's June 30 first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's Wildfire Resiliency Code — language that will shape how development and fire risk get handled in this box canyon for a long time to come. The Hospital District also meets June 25 to dig into mill levy considerations as the push for a new facility continues, and Planning and Zoning holds a work session on the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment Project, the major Town-owned redevelopment proposal that's worth keeping an eye on.

notable.stake: First reading of wildfire code amendments sets lasting development and fire-risk rules.
Mill levy discussion could shape how the hospital district funds a new facility.
Commission feedback on Shandoka redevelopment shapes the project before formal review begins.
